title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-05-31 SGA working record: SGA 6 strict source-checked edition through source page 153
description:
Working public SGA archive for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The record combines existing English translation snapshots, current working translation readers, French reference PDFs, and source artifacts for continued checking.

Status at a glance. [#####-----] corpus-wide working translation material is present. Top-level readers include SGA 1-2 English snapshots, a cleaned SGA 3 English rebuild, SGA 4 as the largest current working reader, active SGA 6-7 partial assemblies, and French reference PDFs for SGA 1-7. The current SGA 5 high-fidelity source-checked edition is paired French/English and complete through printed page 484, including Expose XV, the terminological index, and the notation index. The strict SGA 6 source-checked edition now has paired French/English readers through source page 153. The latest SGA 6 segment continues Expose I on Tor-dimension and rank; the next continuation point is source scan page 154, at the proof of Proposition 6.12.

The artifact ZIP preserves TeX sources, compile logs, source scan slices, render checks, prior segment packets, and provenance notes. These are working scholarly editions and translations, not proofed critical editions.
notes: Latest update adds paired SGA 6 strict source-checked readers through source page 153, while retaining the complete SGA 5 high-fidelity edition.
